response: This code implements the **Circuit Breaker pattern**, which monitors calls to an external function and prevents repeated failures by "opening" the circuit after a threshold of consecutive errors (default 5), then allowing retries after a timeout period (default 30 seconds) via a "half-open" state. When the circuit is open, it immediately raises an exception without executing the function; if a call succeeds in the half-open state, it resets the circuit back to closed.
